blocks.content: A one-day branding and marketing awareness programme was held in Kushalnagar in Kodagu district on 10 August 2026 for around 150 tailor beneficiaries registered under the PM Vishwakarma scheme. The programme covered Artificial Intelligence tools, digital marketing, e-commerce onboarding, QR code generation, and registration on the Udyam Portal.

items: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises administers several enterprise support schemes for artisans and micro-enterprises in India.
PMEGP stands for Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme.
QR code-based payments are part of India’s digital commerce ecosystem under the Unified Payments Interface and other payment systems.
Artificial Intelligence tools are increasingly used in digital marketing, customer outreach, and product listing on e-commerce platforms.
